name: TKEY_YAKU_RIICHI
description: If a hand is in Tenpai while closed, Riichi may be called.

name: TKEY_YAKU_DOUBLE_RIICHI
description: Declare Riichi on the first turn of the hand, before any calls have been made.
notes: Calls that invalidate it include Kan but not Riichi.

name: TKEY_YAKU_IPPATSU
description: Win with Riichi before the next discard after calling Riichi, only if no other calls were made by anyone inbetween.
notes: Calls that invalidate it include Kan but not Riichi.

name: TKEY_YAKU_MENZEN_TSUMO
description: Win by Tsumo with a closed hand.
notes: The only call that does not open the hand is a Closed Kan.

name: TKEY_YAKU_TANYAO
description: Hand composed entirely of tiles numbered 2–8.

name: TKEY_YAKU_PINFU
description: All TKEY_GLOSSARY_MENTSU_P must be TKEY_GLOSSARY_SHUNTSU_P. The head must not be yakuhai. The winning tile must complete one TKEY_GLOSSARY_SHUNTSU from the side.

name: TKEY_YAKU_IIPEIKO
description: Two identical TKEY_GLOSSARY_SHUNTSU_P.

name: TKEY_YAKU_HATSU
description: A triplet of green dragon tiles.

name: TKEY_YAKU_CHUN
description: A triplet of red dragon tiles.

name: TKEY_YAKU_HAKU
description: A triplet of white dragon tiles.

name: TKEY_YAKU_JIKAZE
description: A triplet of your seat wind tiles.
notes: Stacks with TKEY_YAKU_BAKAZE. Can be referred to as TKEY_YAKU_DABUTON/TKEY_YAKU_DABUNAN in this case.

name: TKEY_YAKU_BAKAZE
description: A triplet of the round wind tiles.
notes: Stacks with TKEY_YAKU_JIKAZE. Can be referred to as TKEY_YAKU_DABUTON/TKEY_YAKU_DABUNAN in this case.

name: TKEY_YAKU_HAITEI
description: Win by Tsumo on the last tile from the live wall.

name: TKEY_YAKU_HOUTEI
description: Win by Ron on the last discarded tile.
notes: If the last tile was from the dead wall it can still deal in to TKEY_YAKU_HOUTEI.

name: TKEY_YAKU_RINSHAN
description: Win by Tsumo on a Rinshan draw (e.g. after calling Kan).

name: TKEY_YAKU_CHANKAN
description: Win by Ron when an opponent calls Added Kan.
notes: Some rulesets allow Ron on Closed Kan in the case of TKEY_YAKU_KOKUSHI, but not IRL ones usually.

name: TKEY_YAKU_SAN_ANKOU
description: Three self-drawn TKEY_GLOSSARY_KOUTSU_P in the hand.
notes: If winning by Ron on a TKEY_GLOSSARY_SHANPON, the winning tile is in an open TKEY_GLOSSARY_KOUTSU, not a closed one.

name: TKEY_YAKU_SAN_KANTSU
description: Three kans of any kind in the hand.

name: TKEY_YAKU_TOITOI
description: Hand composed entirely of TKEY_GLOSSARY_KOUTSU_P and a pair.

name: TKEY_YAKU_SAN_SHOKU_DOUJUN
description: One TKEY_GLOSSARY_SHUNTSU of each suit with the same numbers.

name: TKEY_YAKU_SAN_SHOKU_DOUKOU
description: One TKEY_GLOSSARY_KOUTSU of each suit with the same number.

name: TKEY_YAKU_ITTSU
description: Three TKEY_GLOSSARY_SHUNTSU_P in the same suit spanning 1–3, 4–6, and 7–9.
notes: The hand must be interpretable as having each TKEY_GLOSSARY_SHUNTSU as 123/456/789. e.g. 11 234 456 789 doesn't quality for this yaku.

name: TKEY_YAKU_CHANTA
description: Every TKEY_GLOSSARY_MENTSU and the pair contains a terminal or honour tile, and there's at least one TKEY_GLOSSARY_SHUNTSU.

name: TKEY_YAKU_CHIITOI
description: A hand of seven different pairs. Always worth 25 fu.
notes: Can stack with all other yaku that don't need to have TKEY_GLOSSARY_SHUNTSU or TKEY_GLOSSARY_KOUTSU.

name: TKEY_YAKU_HONITSU
description: Hand using tiles from only one suit plus honour tiles.

name: TKEY_YAKU_JUNCHAN
description: Every TKEY_GLOSSARY_MENTSU and the pair contain a terminal (1 or 9) tile, and there's at least one TKEY_GLOSSARY_SHUNTSU.

name: TKEY_YAKU_RYANPEIKO
description: Two pairs of identical TKEY_GLOSSARY_SHUNTSU_P (double iipeikou) in a closed hand.
notes: It looks like TKEY_YAKU_CHIITOI but because TKEY_YAKU_CHIITOI needs the hand to be 'seen' as 7 pairs instead of having 4x TKEY_GLOSSARY_MENTSU + pair, they're incompatible. TKEY_YAKU_RYANPEIKO always wins because it's worth more.

name: TKEY_YAKU_CHINITSU
description: Hand using tiles from only one suit.

name: TKEY_YAKU_KOKUSHI
description: One of each of the thirteen terminals and honours, plus any duplicate of one of them.

name: TKEY_YAKU_SUUANKOU
description: Four concealed TKEY_GLOSSARY_KOUTSU_P.

name: TKEY_YAKU_DAISANGEN
description: Three TKEY_GLOSSARY_KOUTSU_P of all three dragon tiles (haku, hatsu, chun).

name: TKEY_YAKU_SHOUSANGEN
description: Two TKEY_GLOSSARY_KOUTSU_P of the dragon tiles, with the 3rd dragon as the pair. Adds with the dragon Yakus to make 4 Han.

name: TKEY_YAKU_SHOUSUUSHI
description: Three TKEY_GLOSSARY_KOUTSU_P of wind tiles and a pair of the fourth wind.

name: TKEY_YAKU_DAISUUSHI
description: Four TKEY_GLOSSARY_KOUTSU_P of all four wind tiles.
notes: In online rulesets this is worth Double Yakuman, but not in most IRL rulesets.

name: TKEY_YAKU_TSUUIISOU
description: Hand composed entirely of honor tiles.

name: TKEY_YAKU_RYUUIISOU
description: Hand composed entirely of green tiles: 2s 3s 4s 6s 8s and/or hatsu (6z).

name: TKEY_YAKU_HONROUTOU
description: Hand composed only of terminal or honour tiles.

name: TKEY_YAKU_CHINROUTOU
description: Hand composed entirely of terminal tiles (1 and 9 of any suit).

name: TKEY_YAKU_SUUKANTSU
description: Four kans (quads) of any kind.

name: TKEY_YAKU_CHUURENPOUTOU
description: Closed hand in one suit with the pattern 1112345678999 plus any 1 more tile of that suit.

name: TKEY_YAKU_TENHOU
description: As dealer, win by Tsumo on the first turn before any draws or discards.

name: TKEY_YAKU_CHIIHOU
description: As non-dealer, win by tsumo on the first draw, before any calls are made.

name: TKEY_GLOSSARY_DORA
description: Each TKEY_GLOSSARY_DORA in hand (including Ron tile) adds 1 Han. Stacks with TKEY_GLOSSARY_AKA, and stacks with multiple indicators

name: TKEY_GLOSSARY_AKA
description: If a special red-coloured 5 tile is in hand, each +1 Han.

name: TKEY_GLOSSARY_URA
description: When winning with Riichi, tiles below open TKEY_GLOSSARY_DORA indicators are opened and also become indicators.
